content: Letter 1, from Ibn Turka to Sharaf al-Dīn Yazdī, dated 16 Jumādā I [814]/5 September [1411], Isfahan (year bracketed by MK): he longs to rejoin his 'brother and fellow muḥaqqiq', is delighted at Yazdī's letter, and says that on Friday night 16 Jumādā I he is on the verge of setting out at a leisurely pace from Isfahan for the Hijaz (presumably to make pilgrimage). He asks Yazdī to keep writing if he cannot come. A postscript greets his associates and singles out one Yaʿqūb, whom MK identifies with Sayyid Sharaf al-Dīn Yaʿqūb, apparently his protégé and later qadi of Yazd after his teacher's departure (TMN/M f. 160a; TMN/MS p. 1).
